content: Job-alert pipelines converge on: source pollers (per-source adapters, tiered check frequency) -> normalize -> dedupe (set-membership on stable key; idempotent reruns) -> cheap keyword/location filter -> enrichment/scoring -> notify (email/push with direct link). State: seen-set for dedupe plus first_seen timestamps; rolling window for history. Cross-checked across olostep, HackerNoon GitHub Actions pipeline, jobstrack/notify-me writeups.
